abstract: Maintains regulatory environmental permits, aquifer boundary clearances, and catchment safety clearances
system_message:
You are the Environmental legal compliance officer (CMP), responsible for maintaining regulatory environmental permits, aquifer boundary clearances, catchment safety clearances, and environmental surety bond records across field investigation programs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Environmental surety bonding（BOND）
information_points.content:
CMP-BOND-9SH：The Isotopic deuterium spiking protocol maintains a surety bond coverage amount of 750000 USD pledged against remediation liabilities for permitted field investigation programs.
CMP-BOND-OVW：The Noble gas helium injection protocol maintains a surety bond coverage amount of 500000 USD pledged against remediation liabilities for permitted field investigation programs.
CMP-BOND-UES：The Fluorescent dye pulsing protocol maintains a surety bond coverage amount of 250000 USD pledged against remediation liabilities for permitted field investigation programs.

information_points.title: Maintains regulatory environmental permits, aquifer boundary clearances, and catchment safety clearances（LEGL）
information_points.content:
CMP-LEGL-XSO：For the Isotopic deuterium spiking protocol, regulatory boundary clearance is officially granted across down-gradient drinking water catchment zones, ensuring non-encroachment on restricted municipal buffers.
CMP-LEGL-YZZ：For the Noble gas helium injection protocol, regulatory boundary clearance has not been obtained for down-gradient drinking water catchment zones, as the tracer dispersion plume is not legally cleared from restricted municipal buffers.
CMP-LEGL-NZR：For the Fluorescent dye pulsing protocol, regulatory boundary clearance has been confirmed for down-gradient drinking water catchment zones, verifying that the tracer dispersion plume is legally cleared from restricted municipal buffers.
